rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when portraying something in words or conveying its characteristics.

example.english: The report uses a few words to portray the principal’s personality。

rows.note: Use this for portraying a person, object, or scene visually in a drawing or other image.

example.english: This painting helps portray the beauty of Victoria Harbour at night.
example.traditional: 呢幅畫畫出咗維港夜景嘅美。
example.jyutping: ne1 fuk1 waak6 waak6 ceot1 zo2 wai4 gong2 je6 ging2 ge3 mei5

rows.note: Use this specifically when an actor portrays a character or person in a performance.

example.english: The actors portray a group of firefighters in the new drama。
